---
title: "Respiratory virus surveillance, Canada"
format:
  dashboard:
    embed-resources: true
    theme: cosmo
    scrolling: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(DBI)
library(ggplot2)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(odbc::odbc(), .connection_string = Sys.getenv("RSW_CONNECTION"))
canada <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT WeekEndDate, VirusName, Tests, Detections, PercentPositive
  FROM rpt.vw_WeeklyPositivity
  WHERE GeographyName = N'Canada'
    AND SeasonLabel = (SELECT MAX(SeasonLabel) FROM dim.SurveillanceWeek)")
latest <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM rpt.vw_LatestWeek")
season <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM rpt.vw_SeasonComparison")
status <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM rpt.vw_LoadStatus")
current_season <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT MAX(SeasonLabel) AS s FROM dim.SurveillanceWeek")$s
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

canada$WeekEndDate <- as.Date(canada$WeekEndDate)
latest$WeekEndDate <- as.Date(latest$WeekEndDate)

key_viruses <- c("SARS-CoV-2", "Influenza", "RSV")
virus_labels <- c("SARS-CoV-2" = "COVID-19 (SARS-CoV-2)", "Influenza" = "Influenza", "RSV" = "RSV")
# Okabe-Ito colours: distinguishable with common colour vision deficiencies.
virus_colours <- c("SARS-CoV-2" = "#0072B2", "Influenza" = "#D55E00", "RSV" = "#009E73")

latest_week <- max(latest$WeekEndDate)
fmt_pct <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "n/a", sprintf("%.1f%%", x))
fmt_change <- function(x) {
  # Changes that round to 0.0 read as "no change" rather than "down 0.0 points".
  ifelse(is.na(x), "no prior week",
         ifelse(x >= 0.05, sprintf("up %.1f points", x),
                ifelse(x <= -0.05, sprintf("down %.1f points", abs(x)), "no change")))
}
canada_latest <- function(virus) latest[latest$GeographyName == "Canada" & latest$VirusName == virus, ]
box_title <- function(virus) {
  row <- canada_latest(virus)
  sprintf("%s positivity, Canada (%s)", virus_labels[[virus]], fmt_change(row$ChangePoints))
}
```

## Row {height=18%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: !expr box_title("SARS-CoV-2")
list(value = fmt_pct(canada_latest("SARS-CoV-2")$PercentPositive), color = "light")
```

```

```

## Row {height=45%}

```{r}
#| title: !expr paste0("Percent of tests positive by week, Canada, ", current_season, " season")
plot_data <- canada[canada$VirusName %in% key_viruses, ]
ggplot(plot_data, aes(WeekEndDate, PercentPositive, colour = VirusName)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = virus_colours, labels = virus_labels, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), limits = c(0, NA)) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %d") +
  labs(x = "Week ending", y = "Tests positive") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

```{r}
#| title: "This season compared with previous seasons, Canada"
cmp <- season[season$VirusName %in% key_viruses, ]
cmp$VirusName <- factor(cmp$VirusName, levels = key_viruses, labels = virus_labels[key_viruses])
range_rows <- cmp[cmp$SeriesName %in% c("Pre-pandemic minimum", "Pre-pandemic maximum"), ]
ribbon <- if (nrow(range_rows) > 0) {
  stats::reshape(range_rows[, c("VirusName", "SeasonWeekOrder", "SeriesName", "PercentPositive")],
                 idvar = c("VirusName", "SeasonWeekOrder"), timevar = "SeriesName", direction = "wide")
} else NULL
past <- cmp[!cmp$IsCurrentSeason & grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{4}$", cmp$SeriesName), ]
now <- cmp[cmp$IsCurrentSeason, ]

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = past, aes(SeasonWeekOrder, PercentPositive, group = SeriesName),
            colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.5)
if (!is.null(ribbon) && all(c("PercentPositive.Pre-pandemic minimum", "PercentPositive.Pre-pandemic maximum") %in% names(ribbon))) {
  p <- p + geom_ribbon(data = ribbon,
                       aes(SeasonWeekOrder,
                           ymin = `PercentPositive.Pre-pandemic minimum`,
                           ymax = `PercentPositive.Pre-pandemic maximum`),
                       fill = "grey50", alpha = 0.15)
}
p +
  geom_line(data = now, aes(SeasonWeekOrder, PercentPositive), colour = "#0072B2", linewidth = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~VirusName, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(x = "Week of season (week 1 is late August)", y = "Tests positive",
       caption = paste0("Blue: ", current_season, ". Grey lines: previous seasons. ",
                        "Shaded band: pre-pandemic range, where available.")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0))
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: !expr paste("Latest week by province, territory and region, week ending", format(latest_week, "%B %d, %Y"))
tab <- latest[latest$VirusName %in% key_viruses, c("GeographyName", "GeographyLevel", "RegionName", "VirusName", "Tests", "PercentPositive")]
wide <- stats::reshape(tab[, c("GeographyName", "GeographyLevel", "RegionName", "VirusName", "PercentPositive")],
                       idvar = c("GeographyName", "GeographyLevel", "RegionName"),
                       timevar = "VirusName", direction = "wide")
level_order <- c("Country" = 1, "Region" = 2, "Province/Territory" = 3)
wide <- wide[order(level_order[wide$GeographyLevel], wide$RegionName, wide$GeographyName), ]
out <- data.frame(
  Geography = wide$GeographyName,
  Level = wide$GeographyLevel,
  check.names = FALSE
)
for (v in key_viruses) {
  col <- paste0("PercentPositive.", v)
  out[[virus_labels[[v]]]] <- if (col %in% names(wide)) fmt_pct(wide[[col]]) else "n/a"
}
knitr::kable(out, row.names = FALSE, align = c("l", "l", rep("r", length(key_viruses))))
```
